title: MCP-Connected Codebase Migration and Shell Automation
oneLiner: Google Gemini CLI connects to local repositories and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to perform multi-file migrations, inspect logs, and run shell diagnostics from the terminal.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Google Gemini CLI connects to local repositories and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to perform multi-file migrations, inspect logs, and run shell diagnostics from the terminal.
requirements: Google account or Gemini API key
steps: Authenticate with Google or API key
Execute migration prompt in target repo.
configSnippet: "Migrate all CommonJS require statements in src/ to ES modules and verify the build passes."
limitations: Free-tier rate limits apply when authenticating via personal Google login without a paid API key.
